evidence.reason: In `findingDispositionView`, lines 255-260 return `retained` unchanged whenever it is an array. An empty `evidence: []` therefore stays `[]`, even though the adapter contract at lines 229-230 says absent evidence is `null`, never `[]`. The `/evidence` availability entry at lines 269-274 is also skipped because `evidence !== null`, so readers get an empty proof with no missing-evidence signal. This is an existing implementation inconsistency in the adapter, not a new requirement.
